ko.executive_summary: MediaTek launched the Dimensity 9600 Pro, a 2nm flagship mobile chip manufactured by TSMC that narrowly beats Qualcomm's A20 Pro in multi-core performance and cuts power consumption by 61%. The new SoC targets the premium smartphone market, particularly in devices like the Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, while Qualcomm is reconsidering Samsung as a potential foundry partner for next-generation Snapdragon chips.
key_facts: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro uses TSMC 2nm process
Dimensity 9600 Pro narrowly beats A20 Pro in multi-core performance
Dimensity 9600 Pro reduces power consumption by 61%
Oppo Find X10 Pro Max integrates Dimensity 9600 Pro
Qualcomm reconsidering Samsung as foundry for next-gen Snapdragon

implications.text: MediaTek narrows the flagship performance gap with Qualcomm, leveraging early 2nm access to compete in premium segment.
Qualcomm exploring Samsung as alternative to primary foundry partnerships, signaling diversification amid supply chain concerns.
TSMC 2nm advantage enables MediaTek to achieve first-to-market flagship positioning before Qualcomm competitors.

ko.counterpoint: Dimensity 9500 performance scores were lowered by 8.5%, raising questions about benchmark credibility in marketing materials.
